verdict: Whole-package context does not rescue a 7B model: 0 of 5, and most returned files were unchanged. The useful outcome is the side finding that q4_0 KV corrupts generation while q8_0 does not.

title: A cuDNN 8 environment unblocked three tasks
verdict: Switching to cuDNN 8 is the fix for fp16 convolutions on sm_70: all three tasks run, 480p video included; 720p still runs out of memory, so on this card the limit is memory, not the build.

title: Card quality checker without a VLM — 11 663 images, 0.1 % printable
verdict: The library is not printable: 0.1 % reaches A4 and 99.8 % is under 768 px, so upscaling is mandatory; the clipping flag is unusable, with 93.5 % false positives on flower close-ups.

title: LoRA on monstera: training succeeded, no visible benefit
Printing from the 640 px library — x4 reaches A4, not A3
verdict: A4 at 310 dpi is print-ready after one x4 pass at 0.7 s per card; A3 is not (219 dpi) and needs a second tiled ESRGAN pass, which doubles sharpness on the same output size but costs about a hundred times more time.

title: Background replacement with the product kept — SSIM 0.833, but details drift
verdict: Backgrounds can be replaced, the product cannot: product SSIM reaches 0.851 with depth conditioning while contour SSIM stays at 0.701, and the eye confirms redrawn petals and centres. Product cards need a manual cutout over a generated background.

title: Assistant on similar products — 87.5 % on full names, 15 % on short ones
verdict: Retrieval is fine and first choice is not: the right variant is in the top five 90 % of the time but first only 15 %, so the assistant must list the varieties instead of picking one, which is now enforced in the system prompt.

title: CogVideoX on V100 — blocked by the build, not by the model
verdict: With cuDNN 9 video is blocked for a build reason, not a model limit: fp16 convolutions find no engine on sm_70, and without cuDNN the VAE asks 17.8 GiB. The fix is a cuDNN 8 environment, measured in V100-141, not a smaller clip.
